# Infinity Real Estate

> Infinity Real Estate / Infinity Realty (NV). A boutique real estate firm, established in 1994 in Nevada and later expanded elsewhere in the country. Real estate agents in Pennsylvania, Illinois, Nevada and Maryland.

## Contact

- Email: support@infinityresupport.com
- Nevada licence: Infinity Realty (NV) NV LIC #B.1002433.LLC
- Current website: https://infinitypa.com

## Markets served

- Pennsylvania: Central Pennsylvania and the Philadelphia area. Live MLS search: https://infinitypa.com/pennsylvania-real-estate-search/
- Illinois: Chicagoland and surrounding areas. Live MLS search: https://infinitypa.com/illinois-real-estate-search/
- Nevada: Las Vegas, Henderson, Boulder City, Pahrump, and surrounding areas. Live MLS search: https://infinitypa.com/nevada-real-estate-search/
- Maryland: Washington and Frederick counties. Live MLS search: https://infinitypa.com/pennsylvania-real-estate-search/

## How they work

- We can quickly wear both hats, a listing agent and a buyer’s agent.
- We guide them through every step of the process with an extended network of brokers/agents in each state.
- Each client is treated as an individual. Our communication is always clear.

## Questions

- Which areas do you serve? Pennsylvania: Central Pennsylvania and the Philadelphia area. Illinois: Chicagoland and surrounding areas. Nevada: Las Vegas, Henderson, Boulder City, Pahrump, and surrounding areas. Maryland: Washington and Frederick counties.
- Can one agent help me sell and buy at the same time? Yes. We can quickly wear both hats, a listing agent and a buyer’s agent. One firm on both sides of your move, so the dates line up.
- How do I find the right agent for me? Use Agent Match on this page. Pick your state, what you are doing and, if you like, a language. Or call or text the main line at (888) 213-6110 and we will connect you.
- Do you work with investors and rental properties? Yes. In Maryland, Peg Steich owns several rental properties. In Pennsylvania, Joe Geeting has experience in residential and commercial sales and leasing. In Illinois, Breanna Freeburg-Smith works with rentals and Sylwia Baker with distressed property. In Nevada, Ellie Plante loves to work with investors and Jenny Lynn Johnston has sold investment properties.
- Do any agents speak languages other than English? Yes. Dina Valencia in Illinois is fluent in Greek. Sylwia Baker in Illinois is fluent in Polish. Her name is pronounced Sylvia.
- Do you work with veterans? Yes. Jenny Lynn Johnston in Nevada is a certified Veterans Association Representative and loves working with veterans, active-duty members and their families.
- Can I search listings here? Yes. Live MLS search is available for Nevada, for Illinois, and for Pennsylvania and Maryland. The Search homes buttons open Infinity’s current MLS search in a new tab.

Note: roster, titles, years and phone numbers are as published on infinitypa.com and are being confirmed.
